title: AuthorityIntegrityReport
description: Response shape of GET /v1-authority-intelligence/integrity-audit (the `v1-authority-intelligence` edge function). RECORD OF A CONSUMED SHAPE: this schema is transcribed from the already-merged runtime implementation in atlasent-api — this repo did not originate it and must not evolve it here. The runtime is authoritative; a change lands there first and is mirrored here. Auth is an API key carrying the `authority_intelligence:read` scope; the organization is derived server-side from the authenticated caller and is never a client-supplied parameter. The endpoint fails closed: on failure it returns 5xx rather than a partial or degraded report.

IntegrityClassification.description: How a finding is classified. Three-way and load-bearing — this is compliance/audit evidence, not a pass/fail health check. `defect`: something is wrong and should be fixed. `non_exercisable`: the authority cannot be exercised — frequently the CORRECT, healthy state, not a problem. `unresolved`: the audit could not determine which of the above applies, and must never be silently treated as clean. Deliberately typed as an open string rather than an `enum`: the wire vocabulary is closed today, but consumers MUST pass an unrecognized future value through verbatim rather than rejecting it. A validating adopter that enumerated this set would fail closed on a forward-compatible server.

IntegritySeverity.description: Severity of a finding. Open for the same forward-compatibility reason as IntegrityClassification.

IntegrityEvidencePosture.description: Whether the finding was directly observed in the source data or derived from it. `observed` outranks `derived` as evidence. Open for the same forward-compatibility reason as IntegrityClassification.

organization_id.description: Derived server-side from the authenticated API key's organization. Never sent by the client.

summary.description: Open-ended bag. Carries `audited_scope` — including the decision window the server ACTUALLY applied, which is the authoritative echo of the optional `decision_window_days` query parameter — plus counts by classification and severity. Its keys are deliberately NOT enumerated here; the server may add to it, and a client must not treat this as a fixed shape.

nodes.description: Opaque graph nodes. Element shape deliberately unconstrained.

edges.description: Opaque graph edges. Element shape deliberately unconstrained.
